official_pdf_menu_search_attempts: official site lists dishes by name only, no prices
price_overview.fallback_used: Standard Munich beer-hall price ranges (2024-2026) cross-referenced with public review snippets that mention prices.
price_overview.fallback_basis: Bavarian-standard pricing for traditional Wirtshaus + tourist surcharge at Altstadt landmark + 2024-2026 inflation drift.

price_notes.human_action_required: Cross-check against an in-restaurant menu or PDF screenshot of the official Speisekarte. Confirm no surcharge for the upstairs Festsaal.
Confirm whether Weißwurst is included in the morning-only menu or all-day. Some restaurants only serve before 14:00.

price_notes.notes: Maß (1L) beer prices have been relatively stable in Munich 2024-2026 around €11.50-12.50. Cross-check essential.

surcharge_notes.notes: The Festsaal (upper-floor ballroom) may carry a different price tier. Verify if menu is uniform across Schwemme / Bräustüberl / Festsaal.
During WirtshausWiesn (in-house Oktoberfest celebration, typically mid-Sep to early Oct), some items have seasonal pricing. Verify.

tips_and_extras.tip_norm: 5-10% of total, often 'aufrunden' (round up) or 'Stimmt so' (keep the change).
tips_and_extras.notes: German restaurants sometimes add a small cover/bread charge (Brot und Gedeck, ~1-3 EUR) not listed online. Confirm.
